intentions.title: Keep the Barkpark API host and server-only tokens invisible to the browser by proxying every search/admin call same-origin through Next.js route handlers
intentions.evidence: find/route.ts, find-event/route.ts, and admin/reindex/route.ts all comment 'Node runtime: reads the server-only BARKPARK_TOKEN (never bundled to the browser) and proxies same-origin so the client never sees the API host/token'; find-event uses PUBLIC_API_URL + READ_TOKEN server-side only.

intentions.title: Make search degrade gracefully instead of erroring — suggestions, seed, and feedback recording all fail closed to empty/ok rather than surfacing upstream failures to the user
intentions.evidence: find/route.ts suggestions() catches and returns {popular:[],nohits:[]}; find/route.ts GET catches runSearch errors and returns emptyResponse with status 200; search-seed/route.ts buildSeed() catches and returns {index:{},docs:[]}; find-event/route.ts always returns {ok:true} even on upstream fetch failure, only console.error's.

intentions.title: Deliver 0ms perceived search latency for 1-2 character queries via a precomputed prefix index inlined at SSR, ahead of the live WebSocket/API response
intentions.evidence: search-seed/route.ts: 'emits the bundled prefix index the finder uses to resolve 1-2 character queries LOCALLY in 0ms, before the live WebSocket reply arrives'; buildSeed exported for direct SSR call by the (finder) layout, avoiding an HTTP round-trip; cached revalidate=3600.

intentions.title: Close the search-quality feedback loop by capturing 'Did you mean' correction-accepts and result-click interactions, attributed to a per-browser session id, without ever blocking the UX
intentions.evidence: find-event/route.ts forwards kind:'correction'|'click' to /v1/data/search/{DATASET}/correction and /interaction with X-BP-SEARCH-CLIENT sid header for anti-gaming attribution; described as fire-and-forget, 'a dropped signal is acceptable, a blocked correction-accept ... is not'.

intentions.title: Let operators trigger a live Indx blue/green search-index rebuild from the demo, spanning all finder content types, and purge stale cached results once it lands
intentions.evidence: admin/reindex/route.ts POST hits /v1/data/search/{DATASET}/reindex?types=post,page,author,category,project,paper,sheet with a Bearer token, then revalidateTag(FIND_TAG); TYPES comment says it 'Mirrors the finder's content types ... including sheets ... not just Postgres'; 503 if BARKPARK_TOKEN missing.

intentions.title: Keep ISR/tag caches in the demo consistent with upstream content mutations via an authenticated, replay-safe webhook that busts exactly the affected cache tags
intentions.evidence: barkpark/webhook/route.ts: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with timingSafeEqual over 'current' and 'previous' secrets (rotation support), ±300s timestamp tolerance, in-process LRU dedup by delivery id backing the dispatcher's DB-level UNIQUE(endpoint_id,event_id), and tagsFor() reconstructing scoped + flat _all tags plus FIND_TAG for revalidateTag; fails loud (500) if BARKPARK_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset rather than silently 200.
